title: Files, Persistence, JSON, and Networking
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of files, persistence, json, and networking in Swift development.
Apply the module concepts in a small, inspectable Swift example.
Verify examples with a suitable local toolchain or a documented human review.

overview_visual.alt_text: Module 12: Files, Persistence, JSON, and Networking. Lessons in order: File System Basics; Working with Files in Swift; JSON Decoding; JSON Encoding; Codable and Custom Serialization; Property Lists and Data Formats; Persistence Choices; Networking Fundamentals; Using URLSession; Building API Clients; Networking Reliability; Caching and Offline Data.
